## How this work is cited

Passages inside Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus are identified by decimal proposition number (e.g. 6.54). The proposition numbers are the citation and they are self-indexing: 6.54 is the seventh remark under 6.5. The corpus names the work both in full and as 'Tractatus'; the numbers are the same in both.

## The work in Ludwig Wittgenstein’s thought

Ludwig Wittgenstein (1889–1951), born in Vienna to a wealthy industrial family, studied engineering then logic with Russell at Cambridge. The Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus (1921) aimed to draw limits to sense; he then left academic philosophy for years as a teacher and architect’s assistant. [More on Ludwig Wittgenstein](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/ludwig-wittgenstein) .
